newsitem.title: USA: Lucent launches digital cordless phone.
newsitem.headline: Lucent launches digital cordless phone.

text.p: Lucent Technologies has launched a 900 MHz digital cordless phone that offers a range of 4,000 feet, a company statement said Monday.
The statement said the phone, called Digital Cordless Telephone 9510 and priced at $379, could receive and make clear calls when it was almost a mile away from its base.

"This is just one example of the all-new product line Lucent will be introducing this year," it said, adding that the 900 MHz category was expected to grow 44 percent a year over the next three years.
It said the phone's voice signal was also digitally encode in order to avoid eavesdropping.
